propositions: No LOC headroom guard exists for plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC), leaving unprotected files vulnerable to unchecked growth

Registration of workflow steps via @register_step side effect import can silently break if the import chain (workflow_ops.py:45 importing prerequisite_workflow_ops) is removed, undetected by schema validation or existing linters

The assertion justification in test_gate_dispatch_seam.py is stale: it claims three finalize_verdict call sites are in gate_dispatch.py, but all five now reside in plan_review_recovery.py and plan_review/workflow_ops.py (gate_dispatch.py has zero)
Steps referenced in gates/plan-review.yaml (e.g., plan_review_prerequisite_verify_inputs) can go unregistered if their import paths vanish, with no static validation catching the defect

An in-process registry membership check is blind to missing imports because STEP_REGISTRY is pre-populated by prior test imports, requiring subprocess isolation with clean sys.modules to reliably detect registration failures
Existing test_contracts.py:186 cannot catch unregistered steps since it only iterates the already-populated STEP_REGISTRY
